title: Fix nested Tokio runtime in MQTT publish and isolate test HOME from user kanbus.env
description: Rust cucumber scenario 'Contention window closes into LEASE for the deterministic winner' (features/coordination/mqtt_soft_mutex.feature) panics with 'Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime' when a live MQTT broker is reachable. Root cause: gossip::publish_mqtt builds a Tokio runtime and block_on on the caller thread; the step calls publish_coordination_lease_if_ready from the cucumber async executor. CI is green because no broker is reachable there, so publish short-circuits before the runtime. Both Rust and Python harnesses also load the developer's ~/.kanbus.env (KANBUS_REALTIME_BROKER/TRANSPORT), making the suites non-hermetic. Fix: run publish_mqtt on a dedicated thread; isolate HOME in both harnesses.
